'''2015 Worlds Day 3 Mark Walseth DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2015 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Walseth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open BHBM Walseth DS 2015 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125658/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
